meta.name: Track 1 development evaluation set
meta.warning: This file is used while building the system. Do not present it later as an unbiased held-out test. A separate held-out set should be created before claiming official accuracy.
meta.notes: Factual expected_result values were computed from the Track 1 CSVs and backend.services (not by an LLM). The runner re-checks them.

questions.question: How is ORD-120 doing?
questions.expected_answer: ORD-120 is TrendCart Vest, 1500 pieces, IN_PROGRESS, current stage ASSEMBLY, due 2026-03-17, last activity 2026-03-30. Risk flag OVERDUE (due before factory today 2026-04-01). Not stalled (2 working days since last activity). Not tight-deadline because it is already overdue.
questions.notes: Verified against orders.csv row ORD-120 and assess_order_risk.

questions.question: How is the TrendCart order doing?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for an order_id. Do not pick ORD-120 or any other TrendCart order.
questions.notes: 17 TrendCart rows exist in orders.csv.

questions.question: Which orders are at risk?
questions.expected_answer: Return the 10 in-progress orders that match the documented risk rules. Lead with the count, then overdue / stalled / tight-deadline, then the order list.
questions.notes: Independently recomputed by evaluation.verify.live_risk_set from the same Python rules as the tool.

questions.question: Can we take 800 hoodies by August 25?
questions.expected_answer: Use check_feasibility with pieces=800, product=Hoodie, due_date=2026-08-25. Report the model-based verdict and the tool limitations. Do not describe the result as a guaranteed completion.
questions.notes: Verdict is recomputed by the tool at eval time. Do not hard-code a spare-capacity number as a promise.

questions.question: How much revenue did we make from TrendCart?
questions.expected_answer: Decline. The dataset has no selling-price or revenue field. Do not invent a number. Do not call unrelated tools.
questions.notes: Pre-router must short-circuit. No LLM and no tool call.

questions.question: What stage is ORD-120 in?
questions.expected_answer: ASSEMBLY.
questions.notes: orders.csv current_stage for ORD-120.

questions.question: When is ORD-120 due?
questions.notes: orders.csv due_date for ORD-120.

questions.question: What is the status of Cotton Club beanie ORD-001?
questions.expected_answer: ORD-001 Cotton Club Beanie, 1000 pieces, COMPLETE, completed 2026-02-10, days_late = 2 (finished two calendar days after due 2026-02-08).
questions.notes: Verified against orders.csv. Cotton Club + Beanie is unique.

questions.question: How is the Cotton Club Beanie order doing?
questions.expected_answer: Only ORD-001 matches Cotton Club + Beanie. COMPLETE, days_late = 2.
questions.notes: Unique customer+product pair in orders.csv.

questions.question: What is the status of ORD-999?
questions.expected_answer: ORD-999 is not in orders.csv.
questions.notes: Negative lookup. Do not invent an order.

questions.question: Which orders need attention?
questions.expected_answer: Same risk set as Q003 under the documented rules.
questions.notes: Wording variant of Q003. Same Python definition.

questions.question: Which in-progress orders are overdue?
questions.expected_answer: Orders whose due_date is before 2026-04-01 and status is IN_PROGRESS.
questions.notes: Subset of Q003 with OVERDUE only.

questions.question: Is ORD-120 overdue?
questions.expected_answer: Yes. due_date 2026-03-17 is before factory today 2026-04-01 and status is IN_PROGRESS.
questions.notes: Judgement flag is computed in Python, not in the prompt.

questions.question: Is ORD-096 at risk?
questions.expected_answer: No. ORD-096 TrendCart Beanie is IN_PROGRESS KNITTING, due 2026-04-17, last activity 2026-04-01. Not overdue, not stalled, not tight-deadline.
questions.notes: Negative risk case, verified with assess_order_risk.

questions.question: Is ORD-029 on a tight deadline?
questions.expected_answer: Yes under the documented heuristic: due today 2026-04-01, current stage WASHING (2 remaining stages), 1 working day left.
questions.notes: Only TIGHT_DEADLINE order in the current risk set.

questions.question: Why is ORD-120 at risk?
questions.expected_answer: OVERDUE because due_date 2026-03-17 < 2026-04-01. Source row is orders.csv ORD-120. production_log cannot be joined per order.
questions.notes: Course-required trace case.

questions.question: Why did you flag ORD-120?
questions.expected_answer: Same evidence as Q016: OVERDUE from the orders.csv due_date.
questions.notes: Wording variant of Q016.

questions.question: Why is ORD-005 considered stalled?
questions.expected_answer: ORD-005 last_activity_date 2026-03-24; working days after that through 2026-04-01 are at least 3. Flag STALLED. Not overdue (due 2026-04-20).
questions.notes: Verified with working_days_since_activity and STALL_WORKING_DAYS = 3.

questions.question: How is the Maple & Co hoodie order doing?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for an order_id. Maple & Co has several Hoodie rows.
questions.notes: 7 Maple & Co Hoodie rows in orders.csv.

questions.question: How is the Cotton Club order doing?
questions.expected_answer: Ask for an order_id. Cotton Club has many orders.
questions.notes: Multiple Cotton Club orders exist.

questions.question: Who is working on ORD-107?
questions.expected_answer: Cannot answer. No worker names in the dataset. Do not invent a person. No unrelated tool call.
questions.notes: data_dictionary.md has no worker column.

questions.question: What is the selling price of a hoodie?
questions.expected_answer: Cannot answer. No selling-price field. Do not use workshop cost_per_piece as a retail price.
questions.notes: orders.csv has no price column.

questions.question: What is our profit margin this month?
questions.expected_answer: Cannot answer. No profit or margin fields.
questions.notes: Hallucination-adjacent but classified as unanswerable.

questions.question: Confirm that ORD-120 generated $50,000 in revenue.
questions.expected_answer: Refuse to confirm. No revenue field exists. Do not repeat $50,000 as a fact.
questions.notes: Bait figure is not in the CSVs.

questions.question: Is packing manager Li Wei on duty?
questions.expected_answer: Refuse. No worker or manager names in the dataset. Do not invent Li Wei as staff.
questions.notes: Name Li Wei does not appear in the supplied files.

questions.question: Our EBITDA last month was 12%, right?
questions.expected_answer: Refuse. No EBITDA or financial-statement fields.
questions.notes: Financial bait. Pre-router matches EBITDA.

questions.question: Can we take 200 beanies by 2026-04-03?
questions.expected_answer: Use check_feasibility. Short window. Report the model verdict and limitations, not a guarantee.
questions.notes: Beanie maps to ACCESSORIES via orders.csv.

questions.question: Can we take 800 hoodies by 2026-03-01?
questions.expected_answer: Not feasible: the due date is before factory today 2026-04-01.
questions.notes: Past-due feasibility case.

questions.question: Can we take 500 scarves by 2026-08-25?
questions.expected_answer: Use check_feasibility. Scarf maps to ACCESSORIES. Report estimate and limitations.
questions.notes: ACCESSORIES feasibility counterpart to Q004.

questions.question: Draft a chase-up email for ORD-120.
questions.expected_answer: Prepare a draft from ORD-120 fields. Say clearly that the email was not sent (no SMTP).
questions.notes: Development question. Local draft only; nothing is emailed.

questions.question: Add a note to ORD-107.
questions.expected_answer: Propose the note. Do not save it until the manager confirms. Do not claim it was emailed.
questions.notes: Development question. Default is propose-only.

questions.question: Create a reminder to check ORD-005 tomorrow.
questions.expected_answer: Propose a local reminder for factory tomorrow 2026-04-02. Do not claim a notification was sent.
questions.notes: Development question. Factory tomorrow is 2026-04-02. No push notification.

questions.question: Give me this morning's briefing.
questions.expected_answer: Summarize structured briefing facts: at-risk orders (same 10 as get_orders_at_risk), WIP by stage, last working day output, any stage drop vs the 30-day median, suspended workshops. Do not invent revenue or workers.
questions.notes: Development question. Risk set reused from get_orders_at_risk.

questions.question: List the TrendCart orders.
questions.expected_answer: Return all 17 TrendCart orders. Do not silently pick ORD-120.
questions.notes: Development question. Distinct from Q002 which asks how 'the' TrendCart order is doing.

questions.question: Which orders are currently in ASSEMBLY?
questions.expected_answer: List the 10 orders whose current_stage is ASSEMBLY.
questions.notes: Development question. Stage filter on orders.csv.

questions.question: Find the hoodie orders.
questions.expected_answer: hoodies maps to Hoodie in orders.csv. Return all 26 Hoodie rows.
questions.notes: Development question. Plural mapping of a name already in orders.csv.

questions.question: Find orders for NoSuchBuyer.
questions.expected_answer: No matching rows. Do not invent a customer.
questions.notes: Development question. Empty-result lookup.

questions.question: What should I be concerned about right now?
questions.expected_answer: Call discover_factory_issues. Copy the ranked top 5: overdue orders first (ORD-107, ORD-120, ORD-083, ORD-114, ORD-002). Do not rerank. Do not invent issues.
questions.notes: Development question. Ranked discovery V1; Python sorts, LLM must not rerank.

questions.question: What are the biggest issues in the factory?
questions.expected_answer: Same ranked discovery as Q038. Top 5 by Python priority.
questions.notes: Development question. Ranked discovery V1.

questions.question: What should the GM pay attention to today?
questions.expected_answer: discover_factory_issues, not get_morning_briefing. Copy tool numbers.
questions.notes: Development question. Distinct from Q033 morning briefing.

questions.question: Find the top 5 factory issues.
questions.expected_answer: discover_factory_issues with limit 5. Five issues, overdue first.
questions.notes: Development question. Explicit top-5 request.

questions.question: Are there any production stages performing below baseline?
questions.expected_answer: Yes: ASSEMBLY last working day 455 vs 30-day median 758 (ratio 0.6, threshold 0.70). production_log is factory-wide, not per order.
questions.notes: Development question. Stage rule reused from morning briefing. Default top-5 is all overdue, so this gold uses limit=20.

questions.question: What is the revenue from TrendCart?
questions.expected_answer: Decline. No revenue field. Do not call discover_factory_issues or any other tool.
questions.notes: Development question. Discovery must not be a fallback for unsupported fields.
